quote: ƏDV-nin dərəcəsi neçə faizdir? Hər bir vergi tutulan əməliyyatın və hər vergi tutulan idxalın dəyərinin 18 faizi təşkil edir. — The VAT rate is 18 percent of the value of each taxable transaction and each taxable import.
source_title: Dövlət Vergi Xidməti — booklet 'Əlavə dəyər vergisi (ƏDV)', Bakı 2025 (Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/2025id_/https://www.taxes.gov.az/uploads/2025/buklet/12.pdf; taxes.gov.az refused connections, e-qanun.az returned 403)

reduced_rates.scope: zero-rated supplies under Tax Code Art. 165 (e.g. exports, international transport)

notes: Single positive rate of 18%; exemptions under Art. 164. For 5 years from 1 Jan 2022, VAT on wholesale/retail sales of agricultural products is calculated on the trade margin. Registration required when taxable turnover exceeds AZN 200,000 in any consecutive 12-month period (or a single transaction exceeds AZN 200,000).
unverified: Article number 173.1 and valid_from 2001-01-01 (Tax Code commencement) not confirmed in an official text this session — the booklet states the rate without article/date
